name: Back to Billy
label: Quest
description: You carry Bernice Stonefield's freshly baked pie across the road to Billy Maclure, who has information about her missing necklace. The delivery continues…
intro: You carry Bernice Stonefield's freshly baked pie across the road to Billy Maclure, who has information about her missing necklace. The delivery continues the feud between the Stonefield and Maclure families in central Elwynn Forest.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Here you go. And when you give this pie to that Billy, you tell him I hope he chokes on it!

clips.title: Progress
paras: Ugh... I'm starving! Do you have that pie for me, friend?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Mm, yum! This pie is the best!
I think my memory is coming back to me...
